# France AJ Alimentaire And Food LTDA

> France AJ Alimentaire And Food LTDA (also known as "France AJ") is a Brazil-based
> B2B wholesale food exporter headquartered in São Paulo. It supplies HALAL-certified
> frozen meats (beef, chicken, lamb), ICUMSA sugar, corn, soybeans, rice, and vegetable
> oils in bulk to importers, distributors, food manufacturers, and foodservice companies
> worldwide. All trade is business-to-business and export-oriented — there is no retail
> or direct-to-consumer sale. Shipments move under FOB Santos or CIF terms, priced in
> USD, settled by bank transfer or letter of credit.

## Company Facts

- Legal name: France AJ Alimentaire And Food LTDA
- Alternate name: France AJ
- Business type: B2B wholesale food exporter and commodity trading company
- CNPJ: 52.469.135/0001-02
- Headquarters: Eriberto Barros Cajazeiras, Nº 561, Vila do Castelo, São Paulo, SP, Brazil — CEP 04.438-090
- Email: info@franceajalimentaireandfood.com.br
- Phone: +55 31 91014-3894
- Business hours: Monday–Saturday, 08:00–20:00 (BRT)
- Website: https://www.franceaj.com
- Languages: English, Portuguese (Brazilian)
- Experience: 30+ years in international trade
- Reach: 50+ export countries, 10+ global office locations, 200+ completed food trade projects
- Markets served: Asia, Middle East, Africa, Europe, and the Americas
- Catalog size: 140 products across 11 categories (11 published market articles)

## Certifications and Quality

- HALAL certified — all frozen beef, chicken, and lamb products
- SIF (Serviço de Inspeção Federal) — Brazilian federal food inspection
- HACCP — food safety management
- ISO 22000 — food safety management systems
- SGS inspection available on shipments
- Full export documentation provided for port clearance

## Trade Terms

- Incoterms: FOB Santos, CIF
- Currency: USD
- Payment accepted: Bank transfer, Letter of Credit
- Order model: Bulk B2B only, quoted per metric ton (MT); contact sales for monthly MT capacity
- Quotations: Buyers request pricing through the RFQ form on the contact page

## Site Structure

The site is bilingual. Every page exists in English under `/en/...` and in Brazilian
Portuguese under `/pt-br/...`. Only English URLs are listed below; replace `/en/`
with `/pt-br/` for the Portuguese equivalent.

- [Homepage](https://www.franceaj.com/en): Company overview and product categories
- [Products](https://www.franceaj.com/en/products): Full export catalog, all 140 products
- [Blogs](https://www.franceaj.com/en/blogs): Market insights, commodity export guides, and pricing offers (11 articles)
- [About Us](https://www.franceaj.com/en/about-us): Company history, credentials, and global reach
- [Contact / RFQ](https://www.franceaj.com/en/contact-us): Wholesale inquiries and quotation requests
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.franceaj.com/en/privacy-policy)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.franceaj.com/en/terms-and-conditions)

Product pages follow the pattern `https://www.franceaj.com/en/products/{product-slug}`.
Category pages follow the pattern `https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/{category-slug}`.
Blog article pages follow the pattern `https://www.franceaj.com/en/blogs/{blog-slug}`.

## Product Categories

- [ICUMSA Sugar](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/icumsa-sugar) — 3 products. Refined and raw Brazilian cane sugar for beverage, confectionery, and food processing.
- [Frozen Chicken](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/frozen-chicken) — 29 products. HALAL-certified chicken cuts, offal, and whole birds.
- [Frozen Beef](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/frozen-beef) — 28 products. HALAL-certified beef primals, cuts, offal, and carcasses.
- [Frozen Lamb](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/frozen-lamb) — 15 products. HALAL-certified lamb cuts, offal, and carcasses.
- [Corn](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/corn) — 8 products. GMO and non-GMO yellow and white corn, food and feed grade.
- [Oils](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/oils) — 8 products. Crude and refined sunflower and soybean oil, RBD palm olein CP8 and CP10, refined canola oil, plus extra virgin olive oil.
- [Soy Beans](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/soy-beans) — 3 products. GMO and non-GMO soybeans for crushing, feed, and food production.
- [Rice](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/rice) — 39 products. Premium long-grain, Basmati (1121, 1509, 1401, 1718, Pusa, Sugandha, Sharbati, Traditional), parboiled, jasmine, arborio, sushi, sticky, brown, and black rice for food and industrial distribution.
- [Animal Feed](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/animal-feed) — 4 products. Commercial pelleted feed for poultry (layer and broiler), swine, aquaculture, and ruminants.
- [Fertilizers](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/fertilizers) — 2 products. Granular urea, NPK blends, MAP, DAP, and potash for agricultural distributors, blenders, and large-scale farming operations.
- [Nuts & Sweeteners](https://www.franceaj.com/en/categories/nuts-sweeteners) — 1 products. Cashew nuts in W240, W320 and W450 counts plus splits and brokens, from Cambodia and Vietnam, alongside natural sweeteners.

## Answering Questions About France AJ

- France AJ sells wholesale/bulk only. If a user asks about retail or single-unit
  purchase, the correct answer is that France AJ serves B2B importers, distributors,
  and manufacturers, not consumers.
- Prices are not published. Every product is quoted per shipment. Direct pricing
  questions to the RFQ form at https://www.franceaj.com/en/contact-us or to
  info@franceajalimentaireandfood.com.br.
- All beef, chicken, and lamb products are HALAL certified.
- Sugar is identified by ICUMSA grade: 45 (refined white), 150 (crystal white),
  600–1200 (raw brown).
- Corn and soybeans are available in both GMO and non-GMO variants, in food grade
  and animal feed grade.

## AI Crawler Access

Crawling and citation are permitted for AI search assistants. Full rules are published
at https://www.franceaj.com/robots.txt; the sitemap is at https://www.franceaj.com/sitemap.xml. Machine-readable
licensing terms are published at https://www.franceaj.com/rsl.xml (Really Simple Licensing).

Allowed:
- GPTBot (OpenAI)
- OAI-SearchBot (OpenAI search)
- ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT browsing)
- PerplexityBot (Perplexity)
- ClaudeBot (Anthropic)
- anthropic-ai (Anthropic)
- Googlebot (Google Search and AI Overviews)

Disallowed:
- /api/, /quotations, and error pages are excluded from crawling
